meta.name: Symphonica Design System
meta.description: Core, semantic and component tokens aligned with current Figma variables. Semantic.gradient holds reusable CSS gradient strings (var-based). Semantic.overlay.whiteOnBrand: translucent white hover/emphasis on primary-tinted chrome (App Header utility icons, toast controls on solid role surfaces). Core.shadow: card (cards), modal (§5.10 dialog panel), notificationToastr (§5.11 toasts — not interchangeable with card). App shell: sidebar viewport-fixed left rail; App Header fixed top over main column; layout.header.small.stackHeight reserves header space. Modal dialogs (§5.10). Toasts/snackbars (§5.11 Guía 6621-29899): Success | Error | Info surfaces; top 40px right 24px (mobile ≤767px full width between 24px insets); 500px width desktop; Core/Spacing/12 between stacked chips; non-blocking portal; autohide 4s/8s + reading heuristic + pause on hover; critical errors persistent. Alerts, badges, buttons, navigation, cards, and tables use semantic aliases.

llmImplementationNotes.buttonOutlinedInteraction: Outlined labeled buttons and outlined icon-only (card header toolbar) buttons: icon-only uses component.button.outlined.iconOnly → component.button.size.md (38×38 square, 24px Material icon), aligned with header form-control height and filled-primary md—not Bootstrap btn-sm. Default (repose) and disabled states use core.color.transparent background so the parent surface shows through; foreground and border carry the role color. For hover and active, use the nested tokens component.button.outlined.[primary|danger|success].hover|active.(background|border|foreground). Background and border share the same semantic.action.* color (solid fill). Foreground aliases to the matching filled variant foreground (white on brand) for contrast. Do not apply semantic.action hover colors only to text/border while keeping an opaque repose background. Does not apply to table tbody Actions columns: those use circular component.button.icon variants only (never outlined icon-only there); row-level affordance timing follows tableActionColumnRowHoverVisibility.
llmImplementationNotes.buttonIconCircularSurfaces: Default circular icon buttons (component.button.icon.primary|danger) use neutral white hover background for table rows and similar dense rows on secondary app background. Inside Primary or Secondary card bodies (white card surface), use the *Card variants component.button.icon.primaryCard | dangerCard: hover background for BOTH is core.color.neutral.200 (same as component.pill.states.hover.background)—role (primary vs danger) is carried only by icon default/hover/active colors, not by a different hover chip on white. Table action columns and table footer load-more must keep the default variants (primary|danger), never *Card. In tbody Actions cells, whether the buttons are shown at all follows tableActionColumnRowHoverVisibility (row hover / focus-within); once visible, per-button hover still uses this default-variant behavior (e.g. white chip).
llmImplementationNotes.symphonicaIconTooltips: Circular icon-only buttons (tables + card grid/footer rows): require aria-label and Bootstrap Tooltip title aligned to that string unless a shorter tooltip prop is intentional. Delays from tokens.component.tooltip.iconButton (delayShowMs 400, delayHideMs 100); container body to avoid clipping. Symphonica_design.md §5.3 Circular icon button tooltips; §5.4 Table Action Column. Reference: symphonica-ui/src/components/SymIconTooltipButton.tsx.
llmImplementationNotes.tableActionColumnRowHoverVisibility: Table body Actions column only (not footer load-more): circular icon buttons hidden by default; show on tbody row hover and on row :focus-within for keyboard. Use opacity plus Core/Motion tokens for transition; do not animate display. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Pointer-events coordination while hidden is implementation detail; keep controls in tab order. Canonical detail: Symphonica_design.md §5.4, Table Action Column, Row hover visibility.
llmImplementationNotes.navTabsTopSecondaryCards: Inside Secondary Card bodies, section switching uses Bootstrap nav.nav-tabs structure with class sym-nav-tabs-top. Tokens live under component.nav.tabs.top (track border, tab typography/spacing, inactive/inactiveHover/active/disabled). Inactive tab borders are transparent (no box). inactiveHover MUST use primary border on top/left/right (component.nav.tabs.top.inactiveHover.borderColor) plus borderBottomCover matching the hover background (neutral.100) so the tab edge masks the track—do not reuse inactive.borderColor on hover or the border stays invisible. Active tab: white background, primary border, borderBottomCover white, semantic.text.title. Track: bottom border primary. See Figma Bootstrap UI Kit tabs-top. Do not use Pills for this pattern inside secondary cards.
llmImplementationNotes.symphonicaAppSidebar: Primary app navigation is the Symphonica sidebar (Guía de Estilos). Reference: https://www.figma.com/design/7JdlMVI0UphCTyuHFF9Fww/Guia-de-Estilos-de-Symphonica?node-id=7089-7392 Use component.nav.sidebar tokens only (expanded width aliases layout.apiExplorer.sidebarColumnWidth 330px; collapsed 64px). White surface, vertical padding px/py from tokens, Material Icons Outlined 24px leading per row, labels Montserrat 14 medium semantic.text.primary, trailing chevron_right in neutral.500. Vertical rhythm: menuListGap MUST be Core/Spacing/16 between list rows; itemPaddingY MUST be Core/Spacing/8 top/bottom inside each nav link and the menu toggle so the 24px leading icon and label have breathable inset (token-driven—do not zero out in CSS). Search row: 16px placeholder neutral.600, border neutral.400 (Bootstrap text field pattern). Horizontal gap icon–label: itemGap 16. Nav row hover uses component.nav.sidebar.itemHoverBackground (core.color.neutral.200). Collapsed: hide labels/chevrons and search; center icons; no scrollbar on sidebar (overflow hidden on shell and nav); toggle menu_open (expanded) / menu (collapsed). Expanded: scroll only the nav list if needed, not the whole aside. Wordmark "Symphonica" uses semantic.text.title weight semibold for showcase; production may swap asset. Shell positioning: aside.sym-sidebar CSS position fixed; top 0; left 0; bottom 0; width expanded vs collapsed; z-index above default App Header layer edge — rail must never scroll with the main column; sym-app-shell exposes --sym-shell-sidebar-width (expanded/collapsed) and sym-app-main uses margin-left equal so content clears the rail.
llmImplementationNotes.cardNesting: Never nest a Primary Card inside a Secondary Card. The only allowed card-in-card pattern is Secondary inside Primary (e.g. detail clusters inside a main module). When a Secondary Card is nested inside a Primary Card body, set its default surface background to component.card.secondary.nestedInPrimary.background (alias Core/LegacyNeutral/Subtle), not white on white. Standalone Secondary cards on the app secondary background keep component.card.secondary.default.background (white). Borders and Secondary states (hover/active/selected/grid) are unchanged unless the spec adds nested variants.
llmImplementationNotes.subtitleLabelRoleVariants: Card Subtitle Label: strip surface uses component.card.subtitleLabel.surface.{info|success|error}; label typography and optional leading icons use component.card.subtitle.{state}.text and .icon (icon aliases text in Figma today). Layout: subtitleLabel.borderRadius|height|fontSize|fontWeight|variants. Error uses Danger palette for surface/text. Bootstrap form-switch inherits §5.12 primary accents (not Success/Error bar tint). Figma: Subtitle Label.
llmImplementationNotes.buttonGroupSegmented: Card Header segmented Button Group (Figma 7321-12060): continuous primary hairline borders; outer corners component.buttonGroup.borderRadius.container. Unselected segment interior core.color.transparent on white header; selected segment fill semantic.color.primary.base with white label text. Count pills use component.buttonGroup.countBadge (secondary surface, primary numeral, 14px medium, pill radius)—not the uppercase 12px global badge in §5.2. Gap label↔pill component.buttonGroup.segment.labelBadgeGap. Hover/active: unselected segments use component.button.outlined.primary.hover|active; selected segment shell uses component.button.filled.primary.hover|active. Bootstrap btn-group border collapse for shared seams.
llmImplementationNotes.primaryCardHeaderVariants: Primary Card header (Guía Card Primary Header Figma 7230-4966; Filters reference Figma 7872-9277): three mutually exclusive bottom-left patterns — (1) Pills navigation NavPills: optional refresh/download icon-only then pills; never mix with Filters. (2) Filters Simple/Advanced: placeholder-led fields (no visible labels); aria-label or visually hidden labels for AT; toolbar fields target min 160px max 300px width, flex-end alignment with icon-only triggers; clear stays outlined icon-only; advanced tune is outlined when collapsed and filled-primary icon-only when advanced row is open; advanced opens extra row below (no hairline required between rows—vertical gap from header layout token); optional primary Create bottom-right (Create {entity}, add icon—no literal +). (3) Button group + search: segmented btn-group left; bottom-right search + advanced (advanced row below); when both search strip and primary Create required, place Create top-right same band as title. Pills and Filters mutually exclusive. Maps to component.card.header tokens. Symphonica_design.md §5.5.
llmImplementationNotes.cardHeaderFiltersImplementationContract: FILTERS Primary Card header — full step-by-step binding lives in Symphonica_design.md §5.5 subsection 'Filters variant — implementation contract (assistants / Cursor)'. Canonical React markup: symphonica-ui/src/showcase/PartyDomainShowcase.tsx (first sym-card-primary / sym-card-header). CSS: symphonica-ui/src/styles/symphonica.css (sym-card-header__top|bottom|left|right|filters|advanced-row; sym-card-header__filter-field--primary-toolbar | --advanced-toolbar; sym-btn-filled-primary--icon-only for tune when advanced open). Tokens: component.card.header (layout gap column; bottom row alignItems flex-end); outlined icon-only triggers use component.button.outlined.iconOnly → md (38×38, 24px icon). Figma: node 7872-9277. Rules: do not flatten header; advanced row sibling below sym-card-header__bottom inside sym-card-header; tune filled when open; Create uses add icon without + in label.
llmImplementationNotes.symphonicaBootstrapFormAccents: Bootstrap form-control, form-select, form-check-input (checkbox/radio/switch), and form-range ship default blue focus/checked colors in reboot CSS. Symphonica overrides in symphonica-ui/src/styles/symphonica.css (§5.12 block): focus border semantic.color.primary.base + core.focus.ring box-shadow; checked/indeterminate checkbox and radio use primary base; switch focus thumb SVG uses semantic.color.primary.light (#DFE3FA); range thumbs primary base with active primary.light. global.css imports symphonica.css after bootstrap.min.css so rules apply app-wide including body portaled modals. Symphonica_design.md §5.12.
llmImplementationNotes.symphonicaModalDialog: Modal Dialog (Guía Figma 7273-4192): blocking overlay (dim scrim: derive from core.color.neutral.900 at ~45% opacity, e.g. color-mix) + white panel with core.shadow.modal (Guía Shadows/Modal — do not substitute core.shadow.card). Panel corner radius core.border.radius.md (8px Guía frame). Roles: Info = ordinary actions (clone, create, edit, confirm) — title/icon semantic.text.title, primary button component.button.filled.primary sm; Danger = delete / irrevocable — title semantic.color.danger.base, primary filled danger sm; Success = publish / go-live affirmations — title semantic.color.success.base, primary filled success sm. Cancel/dismiss always component.button.outlined.primary sm. Header: optional Material Icons Outlined 24px + gap 8 + title 20 semibold. Body: 14 medium secondary supporting text; optional featured strip surface semantic.color.secondary + semantic.text.primary 16 medium centered/padded per Guía, or role light variants when spec demands; optional Bootstrap form-control/form-select/textarea stacks for flows like Clone or Create Device (vendor/model/version + description). Footer buttons end-aligned gap 8. Accessibility: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby, focus trap + restore; Escape policy product-defined. Motion: Core/Motion + prefers-reduced-motion. Scrollable panel max-height min(90vh, 720px) (tall content scrolls inside the white shell). Full spec: Symphonica_design.md §5.10.
llmImplementationNotes.symphonicaToast: Toasts / snackbars (Guía Figma 6621-29899): non-blocking notifications — Success (semantic.action.success.hover solid chip), Error (semantic.action.danger.hover), Info (semantic.color.primary.base). Title templates Operation Successfully | Operation Failed | Operation Info; optional body 16 medium white; optional sm outlined-light actions (white border, transparent fill, white 14 medium label). Position fixed top 40px right 24px LTR (mobile ≤767px left/right 24px, toast width 100%); desktop toast width 500px; stack chips with Core/Spacing/12; elevation core.shadow.notificationToastr (Guía Shadows/Notification Toastr — do not substitute core.shadow.card); z-index above modal backdrop (e.g. 1080 vs 1050); portal document.body. Autohide defaults: short 4s, long or with actions 8s; optional heuristic clamp 4–12s via max(4s, 2s + ceil(words/14)*1s). Critical errors omit autohide until dismissed. Pause autohide on hover. Never aria-modal or full viewport dimming. role=alert for error; status for success/info. Solid chip hovers: trailing close uses semantic.overlay.whiteOnBrand.emphasis; optional outlined-light actions use semantic.overlay.whiteOnBrand.hover. Symphonica_design.md §5.11.
llmImplementationNotes.symphonicaAppHeader: Application shell App Header (Guía Figma 7219-7632): variants component.header.small vs component.header.large + layout.header.large. Small = primary navBarBackground + breadcrumb band using component.header.small.breadcrumbBarBackground (aliases layout.body.background so the strip matches the main column body — not a separate white bar). Large = hero band: background-color component.header.large.shellBackgroundBase (alias semantic.color.primary.base) plus background-image component.header.large.shellHeroLinearGradient (alias semantic.gradient.heroPrimaryBand). The semantic.gradient.heroPrimaryBand value is a complete CSS linear-gradient string: angle 132deg; stops at 0% semantic.color.primary.base, 40% semantic.action.primary.active, 100% semantic.action.primary.hover — implement with var() references so theme changes propagate. To flatten the hero to a solid, set shellHeroLinearGradient to none or override at product theme layer. Deep breadcrumb band padding component.header.large.breadcrumbBandPaddingBottom; body uses layout.header.large.bodyOffsetTop below layout.header.large.shellHeight so content overlaps lower header (§8). Search uses Bootstrap form-control pattern + Material Outlined search suffix; breadcrumb uses Bootstrap breadcrumb + Material home + help_outline; utilities tray gap component.header.shell.utilityTrayGap; horizontal shell padding component.header.shell.horizontalPadding. Positioning: CSS position fixed; top 0; span main column only (left offset = live sidebar width expanded vs collapsed); right 0; header must never scroll with page body — scroll only the main column viewport (e.g. sym-app-body). Reserve sym-app-main padding-top = layout.header.large.shellHeight (Large) or layout.header.small.stackHeight (Small) so flex body clears the fixed chrome. Utility icon buttons on primary-tinted rows (Large hero, Small nav bar): hover chip semantic.overlay.whiteOnBrand.hover. User cluster account_circle icon matches userEmailForeground (semantic.text.white). Default: no nav-row border-bottom above breadcrumb (component.header.large.navBarBorderBottomWidth → core.spacing.0) — continuous hero unless a fork restores hairline tokens.
